governanceNotes: D1 batch 28 (2026-09-23): deferred on duplicate-scope and manifestation-identity grounds. Encopresis (fecal soiling with retention overflow) is a functional presentation defined by fecal incontinence occurring against a constipation-and-retention background; an encopresis -> fecal-incontinence edge would largely restate the identity (ME-41 phenotype-identity barrier, carpal-tunnel/medial-neuropathy precedent), and the anal-fissure, anorectal-stricture, and rectal-prolapse targets already carry incoming edges from the underlying constipation-and-straining drivers, so an encopresis edge would create parallel pathways already carried by the primary driver identities (diabetes-mellitus-typed-identities precedent).

The upstream causation is inverted in the literature: chronic constipation with retention causes overflow soiling, so the defensible clinical arrow belongs to the constipation identity rather than the soiling presentation; consolidation or inheritance decisions belong to qualified-human governance. Reopening condition: an evidence base quantifying outcomes downstream of the encopresis identity itself (not of constipation generally) would justify re-screening.
